project.name: BanBan
project.styleDefinitionBrief: 成熟克制的搭伴生活平台，暖灰绿 Sage 主色 + 米白中性色 + iOS 原生风格，传递稳定、可信赖、有温度但不暧昧的品牌感受。
project.designRead: iOS mobile app / 不婚成年用户 / 严肃社交搭伴 / 中等信息密度 / 避免婚恋 App 艳丽感

typographySystem.fontStack: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro", "PingFang SC", "Noto Sans SC", "Microsoft YaHei", system-ui, sans-serif

mobileNavigation.activeState: primary icon+label color only; geometry stays identical

structure.innerClass: w-full max-w-md mx-auto grid grid-cols-4 h-full
structure.itemClass: min-w-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-0.5 px-1 h-full
structure.activeRule: only color/font-weight/data-active may change; no class changes that affect layout
